review_candidates.title: L3 Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing complex network infrastructures, resolving critical network issues, and ensuring high availability, security, and performance across enterprise and data center environments. Key Responsibilities Design, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise and data center network infrastructure. Configure and troubleshoot VLANs, STP, SVI, LACP, TCP/IP, NAT, GRE, and P-VPN. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and customer/vendor coordination skills.
eligibility_evidence: Experience: 8-10 Years Location: Hyderabad Work Mode: On-site Work Schedule: Shift-based, including weekends and holidays Role Overview We are looking for an experienced L3 Network Engineer with strong expertise in Data Center Networking, Routing, Switching, and Network Security.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Experience: 8-10 Years Location: Hyderabad Work Mode: On-site Work Schedule: Shift-based, including weekends and holidays Role Overview We are looking for an experienced L3 Network Engineer with strong expertise in Data Center Networking, Routing, Switching, and Network Security. Demonstrated hands-on experience in data center network environments.
